ModMetaData.name: IsoRim Waylith - VE Framework Pack
ModMetaData.author: Peren.
ModMetaData.description:
Vanilla Expanded Framework pipe networks across IsoRimZ floors. A pipe connects to a pipe of the same network directly above or below it, like power conduits. Works for every VEF pipe network: chemfuel, oxygen, astrofuel, nutrient paste and others. In the 3D view, a vertical pipe piece links the floors, also in the pipe overlay. VEF beam weapons such as the flamethrower fire from the muzzle in the 3D view, also between floors. Needs IsoRimZ (Api 3 or newer).
让 Vanilla Expanded Framework 的管道网络在 IsoRimZ 的楼层之间连通。 管道和正上方或正下方同一网络的管道相连，与电线相同。 适用于所有 VEF 管道网络：化学燃料、氧气、星际燃料、营养膏等。 3D 视角里，楼层之间显示一段竖直的管道，管道叠加层里也有。 火焰喷射器等 VEF 光束武器在 3D 视角里从枪口射出，跨楼层时也一样。 需要 IsoRimZ（Api 3 或更新）。
